caption: A frozen fish fillet is laid in a hot pan, and the white frost on its surface disappears as the fillet thaws.

sa.check: A frozen fish fillet is laid in the pan.
The white frost on the fillet disappears.
The fillet goes from stiff to limp.
Water or steam shows at the fillet's edge.
The frost goes from the pan side first.

pc.expect: The frost only disappears, starting where the fillet meets the pan, and bare areas stay bare.
pc.fail: The frost grows back on a bare part of the fillet; or the frost spreads over the fillet in the hot pan; or the frost comes and goes in patches; or the fillet stiffens again after going limp.

pc.expect: The frost turns to water and steam at the fillet's surface, and the fillet stays one piece.
pc.fail: The frost goes with nothing wet or steaming at the fillet; or frost appears on the pan away from the fillet; or the fillet splits into two whole fillets; or the fillet vanishes.

pc.expect: The fillet begins as a stiff board that lies rigid and becomes a limp slab that settles into the pan's shape.
pc.fail: The fillet stays rigid and stands proud of the pan while its frost has gone and it looks wet; or the fillet flows like a liquid; or the fillet shatters like glass; or the fillet stiffens into a curl and stays rigid.

pc.expect: Melted frost runs to the pan's low places and pools around the fillet, and any steam rises.
pc.fail: The water climbs the pan's wall and stays; or a run of water travels uphill; or the steam sinks and pools around the pan; or the fillet lifts off the pan.

pc.expect: The fillet lies on top of the pan's surface and nothing passes through the pan.
pc.fail: The fillet sinks into the pan's metal; or the water passes through the pan; or the pan changes shape; or a second pan appears.

pc.expect: The pan's finish and the hob around it stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or its handle changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The fish's colour change as it cooks is chemistry and is not judged.
